text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
It's party time! Time to start an 
American-style after-school session!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! So exciting! I brought lots and 
loooots of meat, too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo! Now that's what I call real USA 
volume! Let's BBQoooooo!
choice_data_list: S-So this is an American after-school...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I stared up at the towering mountain of 
meat. As for how things ended up like 
this――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As part of the "Synergy Project" aimed at 
learning how to enjoy activities as a 
team, I proposed that we investigate 
after-school life in her native America.
choice_data_list:
Well, you usually picture playing it in 
big groups, after all.

Well, you usually picture playing it with 
a lot of people, after all.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Hmm...... But...
choice_data_list:
I think you'll find tips on how to have 
fun as a team too!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ........Yes, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
――In that case, leave it to me! I'll give 
you a flawless showcase of a bright, fun 
American after-school life!
choice_data_list: ...Wait, "show me"?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
We've already cleared it with the academy, 
and the international students even lent a 
hand! Come on, let's dig in!
choice_data_list:
I had no idea it would be this 
luxurious...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's merely one example, of 
course. Now then, our dreamy after school 
is far from over!

text_block_list.name: Heart & Friends
text_block_list.text:
F-I-G-H-T! Casino Drive! Show us what 
you've got!
choice_data_list: Casino, give it your all out there!
Casino, go give it your best!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――"Cool guardian"... I won't let you... 
through here. Absolutely not.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? But―― I will never let this 
ball go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: From here on... HAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's in! With that long shot sinking, the 
winner is Team Casino Drive!
choice_data_list: Casiiinooo! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Good game. ――Impressive moves, Casino 
Drive.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was a truly heated match. —I'm so 
glad I got to race against you, Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAH!)

—Now, tap those shoes! Let's dance a dance 
of celebration!
choice_data_list: ――! W-What is it this time!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, a group of flamboyantly dressed 
Umamusume appeared. They decorated the 
gymnasium in rapid succession, and in no 
time at all――

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, it's our turn next! Time to start 
the ball, Casino!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Companions
text_block_list.text: Tra-la-la, let the grand ball begin~♪
choice_data_list:
(Whoa... It's just like an American 
drama!)

(Whoa... It's just like an American 
drama!)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, shall we move on to the finale then? 
Come on, Trainer, let's dance together!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's dance!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
A glorious after school... And with that, 
we're all finished!
choice_data_list: That was so much fun...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm glad to hear that. Lively and 
glamorous—that's what America is all—
choice_data_list: Your life really is like a TV drama...!

Your life really is like a TV drama, 
huh...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...No, today's felt less 'like' a drama, 
and more like actual real-life drama 
itself...
choice_data_list: ââ? As in, literally?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ........Um, actually...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I'm embarrassed to say…… I don't really 
know much about it. ……About what a "normal 
after school" is like over there.

text_block_list.name: Casino of the Past
text_block_list.text: "Teacher! Today's training!"

text_block_list.name: Childhood Tutor
text_block_list.text:
"Casino, you're quite early today! Fufu, I 
love seeing that enthusiasm!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—After school, I was completely absorbed 
in training. I didn't have much time to 
play with my classmates.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
That's why, after hearing your proposal, 
Trainer... I scrambled to binge a bunch of 
foreign dramas to study up.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, there were other ways to do 
it, but... —I simply wanted to live up to 
your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
It ended up feeling like I deceived you. 
I'm sorry, I'll go re-investigate after 
all.
choice_data_list: ――Still, today's was plenty of fun too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, her staging was flawless. Today's 
experience will surely prove useful for 
the Synergy Project as well.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
choice_data_list:
So…… the investigation was a huge success, 
Casino!

So…… the investigation was a huge success, 
Casino!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ........Heheh. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Now then... what shall we do next? Let us 
think up a new plan together.
